name: Standalone Character-Agnostic Weapon Sources
owner_direction: Weapons appear in all necessary configurations without any character baked into the asset, so each can be used by any playable hero or NPC.
canonical_grip_policy: Weapon image layer is independent. Characters supply optional pose/attachment anchors, but character sprites must not be embedded in weapon sprites.
source_status: SOURCE_ONLY: sheet and row crops are NOT cleaned individual native-size per-state sprites.

shared_gameplay_state_contract.note: This is a desired state contract, NOT a claim that all these states exist in the art sheets. Match states to actual weapon behavior.

attachment_contract.render_order: equipment behind/front of character according to pose
attachment_contract.mirroring: flip horizontal when appropriate; verify asymmetrical attachments and directional attacks
attachment_contract.collision: weapon effect hitboxes separate from actor collision
